title: BTS Close Sold-Out Lima Run: ~151,500 Fans Over Three Nights
detail: BTS wrapped three sold-out ARIRANG World Tour shows at Estadio San Marcos in Lima (Oct 7, 9, 10), their first visit to Peru. A third date was added to the original two because of demand; attendance totalled roughly 151,500. The members thanked fans in Spanish ('Los amo'), and Jimin was cheered ahead of his Oct 13 birthday. Peru's tourism ministry projected 50,000+ visitors and about $18.7M in revenue. Santiago (Oct 14, 16, 17) is next, then La Plata and São Paulo.

media.caption: BTS 'Los amo' fired up 150,000 in Peru
